# has axis

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasAxis`](gmeow-hasAxis.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasAxis>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a reference frame to one of its coordinate axes.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) -> [`gmeow:Axis`](../classes/gmeow-Axis.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasAxis`](gmeow-hasAxis.md) from [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) to [`gmeow:Axis`](../classes/gmeow-Axis.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

    rdfs:label           "telling order of the novel"@en ;
    gmeow:narrativeTimeAxis gmeow:axisDiscourseTime ;
    gmeow:discourseTimeOf ex:novel ;
    gmeow:frameRealm     gmeow:frameRealmNarrative ;
    gmeow:hasAxis        ex:narrativeOrder ;
    gmeow:dimensionCount "1"^^xsd:nonNegativeInteger ;

    gmeow:requiresHost   false ;

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to relate a reference frame to its coordinate axes.

### Avoid when

- Avoid enumerating n axes for a finite-dimensional vector space — one axis with a coordinate matrix carries the shape ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### How to use

- Attach [`gmeow:Axis`](../classes/gmeow-Axis.md) instances via [`gmeow:hasAxis`](gmeow-hasAxis.md); pair with [`gmeow:dimensionCount`](gmeow-dimensionCount.md) for the declared dimensionality.

### Examples

- ex:siteGrid [`gmeow:hasAxis`](gmeow-hasAxis.md) ex:xAxis, ex:yAxis.
